title: kbtools.py lists the kb MCP tools by the environment of the run and misses docs_search and docs_fetch
goal: kbtools.py lists every kb MCP tool the server can serve, whatever the environment of the run (live-docs, coord and backlog-write tools included), so two runs in two environments print the same catalog

run:
import os, subprocess, sys

def catalog(extra):
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in ('KB_COORD_TOOLS', 'KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS')}
    env.update(extra)
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kbtools.py'], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    return r.returncode, r.stdout

rc0, plain = catalog({})
rc1, gated = catalog({'KB_COORD_TOOLS': '1', 'KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS': '1'})
live = [n for n in ('docs_search', 'docs_fetch') if n not in plain]
print('exit', rc0, rc1, '| live-docs tools missing from the catalog:', live, '| same catalog with the gated tools switched on:', plain == gated)
sys.exit(0 if rc0 == 0 and rc1 == 0 and not live and plain == gated else 1)

notes:
Parked by the review of SP-x6eqtsid (reviewer, 2026-10-24; S2). kbtools.mcp_entries imports kb_mcp and calls tools/list in a bare process: LIVE_ON is set only by kb_mcp.main(), so docs_search and docs_fetch never show, and the coord and backlog-write tools show only when KB_COORD_TOOLS or KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS is set in the shell. The kb_tools MCP child inherits the same. Goal clauses of ST-w6pz5emu and ST-e6xp5h3u: the catalog lists the kb MCP tools and kb_tools returns its lines.
Premise run 2026-10-24 on base f160727aa: repro fails (docs_search and docs_fetch missing, catalog differs with the gated tools on). Check 0 is a gates-off, KB_LIVE_DOCS=0 run that must list every gated name (fails on base). Checks 1 (a default server's tools/list stays unchanged), 2 (kb_ask --route of a docs question stays off kind=tools, since coord_* names join the entries kbtools.answering reads) and 3 (selfdoc.py check) pass before the work: they pin behaviour that must stay. The fix lists every tool the server can serve from one place in kb_mcp.py (one list function the tools/list handler and kbtools.mcp_entries both read), never by setting the gate variables in kbtools.
Docs: the map names embedding.md, plugin.md and token-efficiency.md for kb_mcp.py beside tools.md (in touches); the server's own listing does not change, so those three are named in Self-Reviewed when still correct; the kbtools.py row of tools.md is edited to say every tool the server can serve. tools.md is held by other sessions' items: claim only when held --overlaps is clear. Order: after BG-esbdxtad, before BG-kfv2qrs4 (same file). Planned into the sprint on 2026-10-24 (day run).
